svg.title: Wishbone in a LiteX SoC
svg.desc: The Wishbone main bus of a LiteX SoC. Masters on the left: the CPU's instruction and data buses, a DMA, the host bridge; each goes through an adapter when its width, addressing or standard differs from the main bus. The interconnect in the middle, built by the SoC builder at finalization: an arbiter (round robin on cyc) and a decoder (one slave per address range) for the shared bus, or a crossbar; a timeout returns an error when a slave does not answer. Slaves on the right with their regions: ROM, SRAM, the L2 cache and LiteDRAM, the CSR bridge, a user core, an AXI-Lite vendor IP through a bridge.

g.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
g.text: Wishbone classic with optional incrementing bursts: cyc · stb · we · adr · sel · dat_w → ack / err · dat_r; the map is exported to mem.h, csr.csv, csr.json
